collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager whittles a small fish from a smooth piece of driftwood.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) whittles a small fish from a smooth piece of driftwood. (name1) gives it to a child, who carries it everywhere.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) whittles a small fish from a smooth piece of driftwood. The knife slips, and the fish loses a fin, so (name1) calls it a very brave fish.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) whittles a small fish from a smooth piece of driftwood. (name1) sets it on a windowsill where it catches the light each morning.

e1__fx.name: Ending 1
e1__fx.text: (name1) whittles a small fish from a smooth piece of driftwood. The fish's tail is so lifelike that it seems ready to swim.
